question: With the rapid increase in virtual consultations for healthcare visits reported since 2023, what marketing strategies can MediConn Solutions adopt to continue attracting new customers?

insights.question: What market share does MediConn Solutions currently have in Canada?
insights.answer: MediConn Solutions currently has 19% of the Canadian virtual healthcare market as of our recent study on July 1, 2025.

insights.question: Do in-person marketing events, such as university outreach tables or sales representatives at doctors' offices, increase customer conversion?
insights.answer: Based on a marketing department report from May 2024, potential customers are 60% more likely to start using MediConn services after encountering in-person marketing in comparison to encountering digital ads.

insights.question: How effective are social media campaigns at encouraging new patients to sign up for MediConn accounts?
insights.answer: During our last Facebook ad push, there was an increase of 10% in new patient sign-ups, 6% of which were referred directly to the MediConn site through Facebook ad links.
